purpose: Separate changes in fitted transition support from changes in the reference clinical decision R and its protected set.
fits: Reuse the exact expanded-source model fits; no additional neural training or target-dependent model choice.
source_SP: B and paired decisions come from the expanded-source S/P fits; R is the original matching architecture's S decision. Apply the same complete dual-reference criterion.
primary: New low-flag clinical and paired decisions; retain the original ConvNeXt source-S R case by case.
repaired: Recompute the original calibration-only rescue cutoff using the frozen original R on calibration cases. Preserve original paired decisions on B-positive cases. Do not reuse a cutoff calibrated to the newly fitted R.
targets: Same pooled/subtype sensitivity floors, cancer retention identities under B and R, FP reduction, flag reduction, caps, imaging budgets, external cases and group folds.
reporting: Report pipeline-R and frozen-original-R comparisons separately. The former repeats the original pipeline definition; the latter preserves the original reference benchmark. Do not pool their configuration denominators.
uncertainty: Same 1000-replicate conditional group-bootstrap protocol, run separately per reference contract and endpoint setting.
